explanation: Frank Capra's 1934 road comedy took best picture, director, actor, actress and screenplay. One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest (1975) and The Silence of the Lambs (1991) later did the same.

claims.text: It Happened One Night (1934), starring Clark Gable and Claudette Colbert, was the first film to win the Academy Awards for Best Picture, Director, Actor, Actress and Screenplay.
Those five awards are often called the 'Big Five' Oscars.
The Thin Man, Bringing Up Baby and My Man Godfrey did not sweep the main Oscars, and none of them stars both Gable and Colbert.
It Happened One Night was directed by Frank Capra.
One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest (1975) and The Silence of the Lambs (1991) also won the Oscars for Best Picture, Director, Actor, Actress and Screenplay.
